senses.gloss:
बुक्क r. 1st and 10th cls. (बुक्कति बुक्कयति-ते)
 1. To bark.
 2. To speak. r.
10th cl. To give pain.

बुक्क Subst.
 mfn. (-क्कः-क्का-क्वी-क्वं)
 1. The heart.
 2. The chest.
 3. Blood.
m. (-क्कः)
 1. A goat.
 2. Time.
 E. बुक्क to bark, &c., aff. अच्; also
बुक्कन् mn. (-क्का-क्कं) and बूक्क ।

बूक्क mfn. (-क्कः-क्का-क्कं) The heart; also बुक्क; also with a final न्, बूक्कन् mfn.
(-क्का-क्का-क्क) also बृक्व ।

बुक्कन n. (-नं) Barking, (as of a dog.)
 E. बुक्क् to bark, aff. ल्युट् ।

बुक्काग्रमांस n. (-सं) The heart.
 E. बुक्व् the heart, अग्र principal, मांस flesh.

बुक्वार m. (-रः) The roar or barking of a lion.
 E. बुक्क् to bark, आर aff.,
the lion of Hindustan barks much like a dog.
